name: claim count
description: Count of rows in the canonical claims table.
sqlTemplate: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM public.claims;

name: CSAT responses
description: Claims with a non-empty CSAT rating or feedback response.
definition: A response is populated when csat.rating or csat.feedback is non-empty.
sqlTemplate: SELECT COUNT(*) AS csat_response_count FROM public.claims WHERE csat IS NOT NULL AND csat <> '{}'::jsonb AND ((csat->>'rating') IS NOT NULL AND btrim(csat->>'rating') <> '' OR (csat->>'feedback') IS NOT NULL AND btrim(csat->>'feedback') <> '');
defaultFilter: csat IS NOT NULL AND csat <> '{}'::jsonb AND ((csat->>'rating') IS NOT NULL AND btrim(csat->>'rating') <> '' OR (csat->>'feedback') IS NOT NULL AND btrim(csat->>'feedback') <> '')
